taxon.note: Scientific and common names (and USDA symbol, where given) as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).

traits.height_typical_m.note: FEIS species review, Sorbus sitchensis (Matthews 1993): "a native, deciduous shrub 4 to 8 feet (1.2-2.4 m) tall"; "On rocky alpine sites at higher elevations western mountain-ash is often only 1 to 2 feet (0.3-0.6 m) tall".

traits.height_max_m.note: Abrams vol. 2 (1944) p. 470, Sorbus sitchensis: "Shrub 2-5 m. high with smooth bark"; FEIS (Matthews 1993): "or a small tree up to 20 feet (4.5-6.0 m) tall".

traits.life_span.note: FEIS species review, Sorbus sitchensis (Matthews 1993): a shrub or small tree, "6 inches (15 cm) d.b.h.".

traits.woodiness.note: Abrams vol. 2 (1944) p. 470, Sorbus sitchensis: "Shrub 2-5 m. high with smooth bark".

traits.leaf_habit.note: FEIS species review, Sorbus sitchensis (Matthews 1993): "a native, deciduous shrub".

traits.bark_texture.note: Abrams vol. 2 (1944) p. 470, Sorbus sitchensis: "with smooth bark"; FEIS (Matthews 1993): "bark is thin and smooth".

traits.shade_tolerance.note: FEIS species review, Sorbus sitchensis (Matthews 1993): "Western mountain-ash is shade intolerant and persists in clearings".

traits.leaf_division.note: FEIS species review, Sorbus sitchensis (Matthews 1993): "Leaves are pinnately compound".

traits.division_pattern.note: FEIS species review, Sorbus sitchensis (Matthews 1993): "Leaves are pinnately compound".

traits.division_order.note: Abrams vol. 2 (1944) p. 469, Sorbus: "alternate pinnate deciduous leaves, serrate leaflets": divided once.

traits.leaflets.note: Abrams vol. 2 (1944) p. 470, Sorbus sitchensis: "Leaves bearing 9-13 leaflets"; FEIS (Matthews 1993): "with 7 to 11 leaflets"; the range spans both.

traits.terminal_leaflet.note: Each leaf ending in a single leaflet (odd-pinnate), set by hand from iNaturalist photos (observations 88225355, 107633738, 3536249, 83558082, 135388021, 232196549, 129343023, 52221740): the sources read give no count or measure.

traits.leaf_length_m.note: FEIS species review, Sorbus sitchensis (Matthews 1993): "Leaves are pinnately compound and are 4 to 8 inches (10-20 cm) long".

traits.leaflet_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Sorbus sitchensis: leaflets "oblong to narrowly elliptic … 1.8–6 × 0.6–2.5 cm".

traits.leaflet_width_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Sorbus sitchensis: leaflets "1.8–6 × 0.6–2.5 cm, l/w ratio 1.9–3.5".

traits.leaf_shape.note: Abrams vol. 2 (1944) p. 470, Sorbus sitchensis: "leaflets linear to oblong-lanceolate"; mostly oblong in the photos of the Rainier plants.

traits.leaf_apex.note: Abrams vol. 2 (1944) p. 470, Sorbus sitchensis: leaflets "acuminate to acute".

traits.leaf_margin.note: Abrams vol. 2 (1944) p. 470, Sorbus sitchensis: leaflets "sharply serrate to near the base".

traits.inflorescence.note: FEIS species review, Sorbus sitchensis (Matthews 1993): "Flowers are borne in terminal corymbs"; Abrams's genus (1944 p. 469): "in terminal compound cymes".

traits.flowering_position.note: FEIS species review, Sorbus sitchensis (Matthews 1993): "Flowers are borne in terminal corymbs".

traits.units_per_inflorescence.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Sorbus sitchensis: "Panicles 12–80-flowered, rounded, 2–8 cm diam."; FEIS: 15 to 60 flowers per head.

traits.inflorescence_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Sorbus sitchensis: "Panicles 12–80-flowered, rounded, 2–8 cm diam.".

traits.flower_size_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Sorbus sitchensis: "Flowers 11–17 mm diam.".

traits.flower_merosity.note: Abrams vol. 2 (1944) p. 469, Sorbus: "Petals 5, white, spreading, short-clawed".

traits.flower_colour.note: Abrams vol. 2 (1944) p. 469, Sorbus: "Petals 5, white"; sRGB by eye from the photos (white, the buds pink-tinged).

traits.fruit_type.note: FEIS species review, Sorbus sitchensis (Matthews 1993): "Fruits are small pommes"; Abrams's genus (1944 p. 469): "a small red berry-like pome".

traits.fruit_size_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Sorbus sitchensis: "Pomes pinkish red or red … subglobose to broadly elliptic or obovoid, 7–13 × 7–13 mm, dull, glaucous".

traits.fruit_shape.note: Abrams vol. 2 (1944) p. 470, Sorbus sitchensis: "fruit ellipsoid".

traits.fruit_colour_ripe.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Sorbus sitchensis: "Pomes pinkish red or red (often appearing slightly purplish) … dull, glaucous"; "the fresh fruits of S. sitchensis are often pinkish red; fruits of S. californica and S. scopulina are generally orange-red". sRGB by eye from that wording.

traits.fruit_persistence.note: FEIS species review, Sorbus sitchensis (Matthews 1993): "Fruits ripen from September to October and persist through late winter".

traits.flowering_months.note: FEIS species review, Sorbus sitchensis (Matthews 1993): "Western mountain-ash flowers from June to July"; Abrams (1944 p. 470): May-July.

traits.fruiting_months.note: FEIS species review, Sorbus sitchensis (Matthews 1993): "Fruits ripen from September to October".

generator.params.note: Saskatoon's (amelanchier-alnifolia) values, changed by hand for Sitka mountain-ash: a few stems, longer pinnate leaves (leaf card 15 cm for FEIS's 10-20 cm leaves), and one erect, flat-topped cluster at the tip of a shoot (FEIS: terminal corymbs). Not fitted to measurements.

appearance.note: By eye, from the photos the traits cite: an open shrub of several smooth, reddish-grey stems, pinnate leaves of many oblong, toothed leaflets, flat clusters of white flowers and coral-red fruit. Organ cards from western serviceberry's (amelanchier-alnifolia), recoloured and resized by hand. Colours set by eye were written as screen (sRGB) shades; they are read as the linear light a colour field holds, and bark and foliage follow the stated colour traits by rule (2026-10-19).

allometry.note: 1.8 m tall at 12 years in the open, within its sources' range, as it grows in subalpine parkland. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.

traits.stem_clump.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Sorbus sitchensis: "Shrubs, 10–40 dm. Stems 1–8".

traits.stamens.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Sorbus sitchensis: "stamens 15–20".
